tools.name: text_metrics
tools.description: Measure text deterministically: characters, words, unique words, sentences, lines, paragraphs, digits, punctuation, average word and sentence length, reading time and an Arabic/Latin language mix. Works on any language, not only Arabic.

tools.name: text_normalize
tools.description: Canonicalise Arabic text for search, matching or indexing: remove tashkeel and tatweel, fold alef/ya/ta-marbuta, unify Arabic-Indic digits, strip bidi control characters and collapse whitespace. mode=light is lossless; search adds letter folding; index also strips punctuation so the result can be us

tools.name: text_detect_language
tools.description: Identify whether text is Arabic, English, mixed or unknown from its script mix, with a confidence score and the count of Arabic, Latin and other letters. Deterministic and model-free, so it is cheap enough to run on every incoming message to route Arabic work.

tools.name: text_chunk
tools.description: Split long text into chunks for a model context window. Cuts at sentence boundaries when possible, then at word boundaries, and never mid-word unless a single word is longer than max_chars. Returns each chunk with exact start/end offsets into the original string plus an optional overlap for context

tools.name: text_diff
tools.description: Compare two texts word by word after Arabic normalisation (tashkeel, alef/ya/ta-marbuta and digit variants are treated as equal). Returns an equal flag, a similarity score and the added and removed words. Use it for deduplication, re-import checks and QA of edited Arabic copy. Each side is limited t

tools.name: text_search
tools.description: Search Arabic (or any) text with normalisation: tashkeel, alef/ya/ta-marbuta, hamza and Arabic-Indic digit variants are ignored, so فَاطِمَة matches فاطمة and ١٢٣ matches 123. mode=words (default) matches whole words, phrase matches any substring, fuzzy tolerates up to max_distance edits per word. R

tools.name: audio_transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe Arabic or English speech to plain text. Send the audio as base64 (webm, mp3, wav or mp4); the payload limit is 12 MB of base64. Returns the transcript plus the model that produced it.

tools.name: doc_extract
tools.description: Extract structured fields from an Arabic document image or PDF (receipts, invoices, official letters, national IDs, bank slips) as JSON: amounts, dates, names, identifiers and tax numbers, with null for fields the document does not contain. Send the file as base64 (jpeg, png or pdf); the limit is 12

tools.name: doc_extract_batch
tools.description: Extract structured fields from 1 to 5 Arabic documents in one paid call: $0.10 for the batch, i.e. $0.02 per document instead of $0.03.
